_note: Curated directory of Indian grievance channels. Scope: 'central' (all India), 'state' (state-specific; 'states' lists which), 'city' (city-specific). Always tell the citizen to verify URLs/helplines before filing. Add entries freely — the agent reads this file at runtime.

authorities.name: CPGRAMS — Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (DARPG)
authorities.handles: Grievances against any Central Government ministry/department and its organisations; also routes to state governments. Central pensioners use the pension (CPENGRAMS) section.

file_via.notes: Register, choose ministry/department, attach documents. Also available as the CPGRAMS mobile app and via Common Service Centres.

authorities.timeline_note: Central government guidelines (Aug 2024) set a maximum of 21 days for grievance disposal; an interim reply is expected if more time is needed.
escalation: Appeal on the same portal after closure if dissatisfied
RTI to the concerned ministry asking for action-taken report

authorities.name: Municipal Corporation / Nagar Nigam / Nagar Palika (urban local body)
authorities.handles: City roads (non-highway), potholes, streetlights, garbage collection, drains, local water supply in many cities, birth/death certificates.

file_via.notes: Most cities have a grievance portal or app on the municipal website. Search '<city> municipal corporation complaint'.
Swachhata-MoHUA mobile app (Android/iOS) for garbage, sanitation, public toilets in urban areas.
Submit to the Ward Office / Executive Engineer; keep a stamped receiving copy.

authorities.timeline_note: Many states notify service timelines under their Right to Public Services Act or the city's Citizen Charter.
escalation: CM grievance portal of the state
RTI asking for status and responsible officer

authorities.name: Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office (rural local body)
authorities.handles: Village roads, handpumps/water, sanitation, MGNREGA job cards and work, rural housing scheme lists.

file_via.notes: Raise in Gram Sabha or submit written complaint to Panchayat Secretary; escalate to BDO.
Check job card, muster rolls and payment status.

authorities.timeline_note: Under MGNREGA, work must be provided within 15 days of demand and wages paid within 15 days of the muster roll closing; delayed wages earn compensation.
escalation: Ombudsperson for MGNREGA in the district

authorities.name: State Public Works Department (PWD) — Roads
authorities.handles: State highways, major district roads and bridges maintained by the state.

file_via.channel: State PWD website / CM grievance portal
file_via.notes: Many states run road-complaint apps; otherwise write to the Executive Engineer of the PWD division.

authorities.name: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)
authorities.handles: Potholes, safety hazards, toll plaza issues on National Highways.

file_via.notes: Call 1033 from any phone while on a National Highway; also the 'Rajmargyatra' app.

authorities.name: Electricity Distribution Company (DISCOM) + Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum
authorities.handles: Power cuts, wrong bills, meter faults, new connection delays, voltage problems.

file_via.notes: 1912 is the common electricity complaint number in many states; always note the complaint/docket number.
If the DISCOM does not resolve the complaint, file before the CGRF of your DISCOM.

authorities.timeline_note: Electricity (Rights of Consumers) Rules, 2020 set maximum times for new connections (7 days metro / 15 days other municipal areas / 30 days rural) and provide for compensation when DISCOMs miss standards.
escalation: Electricity Ombudsman of the State Electricity Regulatory Commission

authorities.name: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (via the bank's grievance cell first)
authorities.handles: Deficiency in service by banks, NBFCs, payment system operators: failed transactions, unfair charges, loan harassment, card issues.

file_via.notes: Complain to the bank first and keep the reference number.
If the bank rejects or does not reply within 30 days, file with the RBI Ombudsman (generally within one year of the bank's reply).

authorities.timeline_note: Bank gets 30 days to resolve before you can approach the RBI Ombudsman.

authorities.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (I4C, MHA)
authorities.handles: Online financial fraud, UPI/card scams, social-media harassment, sextortion.

file_via.channel: Helpline 1930 — call immediately for money frauds
file_via.notes: Calling within the first hours ('golden hour') gives the best chance of freezing the money.
Keep transaction IDs, screenshots, phone numbers, UPI IDs.
Report fraud calls/SMS and block lost phones.

authorities.name: National Consumer Helpline + Consumer Commission (e-Daakhil)
authorities.handles: Defective goods, deficient services, refunds, MRP overcharging, e-commerce disputes.

file_via.notes: Call 1915 or WhatsApp; pre-litigation mediation with the company.
District Commission handles claims up to ₹50 lakh; State ₹50 lakh–₹2 crore; National above ₹2 crore.

authorities.timeline_note: A consumer complaint must generally be filed within 2 years of the cause of action (Sec. 69, Consumer Protection Act, 2019).

authorities.name: Public Distribution System — District Grievance Redressal Officer (NFSA)
authorities.handles: Ration not given, short weight, ration card not issued or deleted, fair-price shop misconduct.

file_via.notes: Many states use 1967 or 1800-series food helplines.
Every district must have a DGRO under Sec. 15 of the National Food Security Act, 2013.

escalation: State Food Commission (appeal against DGRO order)

authorities.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (National Health Authority)
authorities.handles: Empanelled hospital refusing cashless treatment, asking money from PM-JAY beneficiaries, card problems.

file_via.notes: Call 14555 or file on the grievance portal.

authorities.name: Rail Madad (Indian Railways)
authorities.handles: Complaints during or about train journeys: cleanliness, security, refunds, staff behaviour.

file_via.notes: Call 139 or use the RailMadad app; share PNR.

authorities.name: Police / Emergency Response
authorities.handles: Any emergency or crime. FIR for cognizable offences; e-FIR/online complaint in most states for theft and lost items.

file_via.notes: 112 (all emergencies), 181 (women helpline), 1098 (children), 108 (ambulance in most states).
Police must register an FIR for cognizable offences; Zero FIR can be filed at any station.

authorities.name: Labour Department / SAMADHAN portal
authorities.handles: Unpaid wages, illegal termination, PF/ESI issues.

file_via.notes: For industrial disputes in the central sphere; state labour departments handle others.
For provident fund withdrawal/transfer problems.

authorities.name: Education Department / State Commission for Protection of Child Rights (RTE)
authorities.handles: RTE 25% seat denial in private schools, capitation fees, scholarship not credited, school infrastructure.

file_via.notes: Written complaint with admission documents.
For central scholarship status/grievances.

escalation: State Commission for Protection of Child Rights
National Commission for Protection of Child Rights

authorities.name: Social Welfare Department — Old age / widow / disability pensions (NSAP & state schemes)
authorities.handles: Social security pension not sanctioned, stopped, or delayed.

file_via.notes: Written complaint with pension ID, bank passbook, Aadhaar copy.
Check sanction and payment status.

authorities.name: Telecom operator appellate authority / TRAI consumer guidance
authorities.handles: Billing disputes, network issues, unwanted commercial calls.

file_via.channel: Operator complaint centre, then operator's Appellate Authority
file_via.notes: Keep the docket number; appeal if unresolved.
Report spam/fraud communication via Chakshu; register DND by SMS 1909.

authorities.name: State Chief Minister's grievance portal
authorities.handles: Any grievance against a state government department; useful escalation when the department ignores you.

file_via.notes: Most states run one (e.g. Jansunwai, CM Helpline). Search '<state> CM grievance portal'.

authorities.name: Guwahati Municipal Corporation (GMC)
authorities.handles: Municipal roads, drains, garbage and streetlights within Guwahati city limits.

file_via.notes: Submit to the concerned zonal office; ask for a stamped receipt or complaint number.

escalation: Guwahati Development Department, Govt. of Assam

authorities.name: Assam Power Distribution Company Ltd (APDCL)
authorities.handles: Electricity supply and billing in Assam.

file_via.notes: Call 1912; note the docket number.

escalation: Electricity Ombudsman, Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission

authorities.name: Assam Right to Public Services (RTPS) portal
authorities.handles: Time-bound delivery of notified services (certificates, licences, mutation) under the Assam Right to Public Services Act, 2012.

file_via.notes: Apply/track notified services; if the stipulated time lapses, appeal to the Appellate Authority.

escalation: Appellate Authority under Assam RTPS Act
